evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce CoCoBench, a construct-level benchmark for evaluating multi-agent embodied coordination in executable household tasks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Most benchmarks either focus on single-agent task completion or summarize multi-agent behavior with overall task success rates, which can obscure coordination failures such as duplicated work, violations of ordering constraints, resource contention, and desynchronized handoffs.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In addition to task success rate, CoCoBench provides construct-level scores that measure whether agents coordinate effectively.
